import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    inbound = inputs["inbound"].copy()
    target_snapshot = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()

    # Step 1: STG_NEW = SELECT product_id, batch_date, SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
    #                          MAX(unit_cost) AS max_unit_cost
    #          FROM inbound WHERE qty > 0 GROUP BY product_id, batch_date
    filtered = inbound[inbound["qty"] > 0]

    if filtered.empty:
        stg_new = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]
        )
    else:
        grouped = (
            filtered.groupby(["product_id", "batch_date"], dropna=False)
            .agg(total_qty=("qty", "sum"), max_unit_cost=("unit_cost", "max"))
            .reset_index()
        )
        stg_new = grouped[
            ["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]
        ]

    # Step 2: DELETE FROM TARGET_SNAPSHOT
    #   WHERE batch_date IN (SELECT DISTINCT batch_date FROM STG_NEW)
    # SQL IN semantics: NULL batch_date never matches, regardless of list content.
    if not stg_new.empty:
        arriving_dates = pd.unique(stg_new["batch_date"].dropna())
        delete_mask = target_snapshot["batch_date"].notna() & target_snapshot[
            "batch_date"
        ].isin(arriving_dates)
    else:
        delete_mask = pd.Series(False, index=target_snapshot.index)

    survivors = target_snapshot[~delete_mask]

    # Step 3: INSERT INTO TARGET_SNAPSHOT SELECT * FROM STG_NEW
    result = pd.concat([survivors, stg_new], ignore_index=True, sort=False)

    result = result[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]]

    return {"target_snapshot": result}
